usedFor: Gumlet hosts video assets, and Freshsales Classic tracks deals, so “New Video Asset” can drive “Update Deal”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Video Asset” in Gumlet, then “Update Deal” in Freshsales Classic
bestTemplate.why: A new video can move a deal along, for example by updating its stage or notes.

watchOut: “New Video Asset” is polling, and “Update Deal” finds the deal by ID or name, so supply one.
